## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, previous behavior, and resulting behavior.

## Authority and scope

Link the issue or adopted change/task. Identify affected contracts and consumers.

## Validation

List commands actually executed and their results. Record `not_run` checks and limitations. Include bilingual documentation and Workbook checks when affected.

## Review and delivery

Identify remaining independent review, acceptance, or release requirements. Confirm that the diff preserves unrelated work.
